id: 13_Experiment on measurement of Line and Phase Quantities of Star and Delta Connect
title: 星形与三角形连接系统的线量与相量测量
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/13_Experiment on measurement of Line and Phase Quantities of Star and Delta Connect.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/13_Experiment on measurement of Line and Phase Quantities of Star and Delta Connect/src.py

points.K5: 星形：线电流就是相电流
points.K6: 线电压与相电压怎么测
points.K10: 三角形：首尾相接成闭环
points.K11: 三角形：线电压就是相电压
points.K12: 三角形的用途（原片说法）

shots.scene: 欣欣站在三相实验台前，台上三只灯泡排成一排
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a three-phase lab bench with three light bulbs in a row and a large variable autotransformer cabinet, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天做三相实验：星形和三角形！
overlay: 星形与三角形连接系统的线量与相量测量

shots.scene: 星形和三角形两个图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: three loads joined in a star shape and three loads joined in a triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 同样三只灯，换个接法大不同。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着两组一样的灯，一组暗一组亮，挠头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at two identical sets of bulbs, one dim and one bright, and scratches his head.
shots.narration: 阿杰奇怪：同样的灯，亮度怎么不同？

shots.scene: 小研笑着拿出电路图
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and holds up a blank circuit diagram sheet.
shots.narration: 小研说：答案就在接法里。

shots.scene: 王老师指着星形和三角形图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at the star and triangle icons on a board.
shots.narration: 测两种接法的线电压和相电压。

shots.scene: 线电流、相电流两个箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: Two arrow icons, one on a supply line and one inside a load branch. No people.
shots.narration: 还有线电流、相电流，找出关系。

shots.scene: 阿杰在本子上画两种接线图
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sketches two wiring diagrams in a notebook.
shots.narration: 学会三相接线，分清两种接法。

shots.scene: 两只动铁式交流电压表，表盘双量程
shots.prompt_en: Two moving-iron AC voltmeters with dual-range blank dials on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 动铁式电压表两只，零到三百或六百伏。

shots.scene: 两只交流电流表
shots.prompt_en: Two moving-iron AC ammeters with blank dials. No people.
shots.narration: 动铁式电流表两只，零到二安。

shots.scene: 三相灯负载板和一捆导线
shots.prompt_en: A three-phase lamp load board with three bulbs and a bundle of connecting wires. No people.
shots.narration: 三相灯负载一套，导线要通断良好。

shots.scene: 三个线圈图标，尾端连在一起成一个点
shots.prompt_en: Three coil icons whose ending terminals are joined together at one central point. No people.
shots.narration: 星形：三相线圈的同名端接在一起。

shots.scene: 中心连接点高亮
shots.prompt_en: The central joining point highlights. No people.
shots.narration: 这个公共点就是中性点。

shots.scene: 三只一样的白炽灯
shots.prompt_en: Three identical incandescent bulbs on lamp holders. No people.
shots.narration: 三只同规格白炽灯当三相负载。

shots.section_title: 星形：线电流就是相电流
shots.scene: 星形图中一根相线上串一只电流表
shots.prompt_en: A star connection icon with one ammeter placed in a supply line leading to one load. No people.
shots.narration: 星形里，线电流就是相电流。
overlay: 星形：线电流就是相电流

shots.section_title: 星形：线电流就是相电流
shots.scene: 一只电流表同时挂两个空白标签
shots.prompt_en: One ammeter icon with two blank tags attached. No people.
shots.narration: 一只电流表就能同时测出两者。

shots.section_title: 线电压与相电压怎么测
shots.scene: 大量程电压表跨在两根相线之间
shots.prompt_en: A high-range voltmeter icon connected between two supply lines. No people.
shots.narration: 两根相线之间是线电压，用大量程表。
overlay: 线电压与相电压怎么测

shots.section_title: 线电压与相电压怎么测
shots.scene: 小量程电压表跨在一根相线和中性点之间
shots.prompt_en: A lower-range voltmeter icon connected between one supply line and the neutral point. No people.
shots.narration: 相线和中性点之间是相电压，用小量程。

shots.section_title: 线电压与相电压怎么测
shots.scene: 电路图上电压表符号旁画一个交流波形
shots.prompt_en: A voltmeter symbol on a circuit diagram with a small AC wave mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 交流表，图上要标交流符号。

shots.scene: 电路图：三相电源接调压器，再接灯
shots.prompt_en: A diagram icon: a three-phase supply feeding a three-phase autotransformer, which feeds the lamp load. No people.
shots.narration: 电源经三相调压器加到负载上。

shots.scene: 手转调压器柜顶上的旋钮
shots.prompt_en: A hand turns the knob on top of a three-phase variable autotransformer cabinet.
shots.narration: 调压器加线电压，再测相电压和电流。

shots.scene: 老周比划高电压小电流
shots.prompt_en: The older man gestures with one hand high and one hand low beside a star icon.
shots.narration: 原片说：星形用于高电压小电流。

shots.scene: 接线、合闸两个步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: Two step icons: a circuit diagram and a supply switch closing. No people.
shots.narration: 按图接线，合上电源开关。

shots.scene: 调压器旋钮转高，电压表指向四百
shots.prompt_en: An autotransformer knob turned up while a voltmeter needle rises high. No people.
shots.narration: 用调压器加到四百伏线电压。

shots.scene: 读数、回零、断开三个步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: Three step icons: a meter being read, the knob turned back to zero, and the switch opened. No people.
shots.narration: 记下各表读数，回零，断开开关。

shots.scene: 相电压乘根号三，和线电压放在天平两端
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a phase voltage icon times a root-three symbol on one side and a line voltage icon on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 相电压乘根号三，应等于线电压。

shots.section_title: 三角形：首尾相接成闭环
shots.scene: 三个线圈首尾相接围成三角形
shots.prompt_en: Three coil icons connected end to start, forming a closed triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 三角形：一相的尾接下一相的头。
overlay: 三角形：首尾相接成闭环

shots.section_title: 三角形：首尾相接成闭环
shots.scene: 三角形中间空着，没有中心点
shots.prompt_en: A triangle connection icon with an empty center and a small question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 首尾相接成闭环，没有中性点。

shots.section_title: 三角形：线电压就是相电压
shots.scene: 一只电压表跨在三角形一边
shots.prompt_en: One voltmeter icon connected across one side of the triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 三角形里，线电压就是相电压。
overlay: 三角形：线电压就是相电压

shots.section_title: 三角形：线电压就是相电压
shots.scene: 两只电流表：一只在相线，一只在三角形一边
shots.prompt_en: Two ammeter icons: one in a supply line, one inside one side of the triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 一只电压表就够，两只电流表分测。

shots.section_title: 三角形的用途（原片说法）
shots.scene: 老周比划大电流低电压
shots.prompt_en: The older man gestures with one hand low and one hand wide beside a triangle icon.
shots.narration: 原片说：三角形用于大电流低电压。
overlay: 三角形的用途（原片说法）

shots.scene: 三极开关合上，调压器旋钮只转一小段
shots.prompt_en: A three-pole switch is closed, and the autotransformer knob is turned only a short way.
shots.narration: 接线合闸，只升到二百三十伏。

shots.scene: 老周补充：二百伏也可以
shots.prompt_en: The older man raises a finger, adding a remark.
shots.narration: 二百伏也可以。

shots.scene: 记录表和调压器回零图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank data table and an autotransformer knob back at zero. No people.
shots.narration: 读数记表，回零，断开开关。

shots.scene: 星形灯泡暗淡
shots.prompt_en: A star-connected lamp board with bulbs glowing dimly. No people.
shots.narration: 星形时电压低，灯很暗。

shots.scene: 三角形灯泡在较低电压下就亮了
shots.prompt_en: The triangle-connected bulbs light up brightly while the autotransformer knob is only slightly turned. No people.
shots.narration: 三角形电压很低，灯也很快亮起来。

shots.scene: 墙上配电板上的三极开关和红色工业插座
shots.prompt_en: A three-pole switch on a wall distribution board beside a red three-phase industrial socket. No people.
shots.narration: 墙上这个是三极单掷开关。

shots.scene: 调压器柜正面的输入和输出端子
shots.prompt_en: The front of the autotransformer cabinet with a row of input terminals and a row of output terminals, colored red, yellow and blue. No people.
shots.narration: 调压器有输入端，红黄蓝三相。

shots.scene: 透明面板上三只灯和三块表
shots.prompt_en: Three bulbs on a clear panel next to two voltmeters and an ammeter with blank dials. No people.
shots.narration: 这是三只灯、电压表和电流表。

shots.scene: 导线从调压器输出端引向灯板和电表
shots.prompt_en: Wires run from the autotransformer output terminals to the lamp board and meters. No people.
shots.narration: 接线从调压器输出端开始。

shots.scene: 阿杰合上墙上的三极开关
shots.prompt_en: The young male student closes the three-pole switch on the wall board.
shots.narration: 接成星形，合上三极开关。

shots.scene: 阿杰转调压器，眼睛盯着线电压表
shots.prompt_en: The young male student turns the autotransformer knob while watching the line voltmeter.
shots.narration: 转调压器时，眼睛盯住线电压表。

shots.scene: 表盘上排刻度高亮，指针接近四百
shots.prompt_en: A voltmeter dial with its upper scale highlighted, the needle near the high end. No people.
shots.narration: 升到四百伏，读上排刻度。

shots.scene: 小研用手指着电流表和相电压表读数，记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points with her finger at the ammeter and the phase voltmeter and writes on a blank sheet.
shots.narration: 再读电流和相电压，记下来。

shots.scene: 三只灯发光
shots.prompt_en: Three star-connected bulbs glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 看看三只灯的亮度。

shots.scene: 阿杰把调压器转回零，扳下开关
shots.prompt_en: The young male student turns the autotransformer back to zero, then opens the three-pole switch.
shots.narration: 调压器回零，断开开关。

shots.scene: 黑板上画着三角形连接图
shots.prompt_en: A chalkboard with a hand-drawn triangle connection diagram without any words. No people.
shots.narration: 改接成三角形。

shots.scene: 阿杰合上开关，慢慢转调压器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student closes the switch and slowly turns the autotransformer knob.
shots.narration: 合上开关，慢慢升到较低电压。

shots.scene: 电压表下排刻度高亮
shots.prompt_en: A voltmeter dial with its lower scale highlighted, the needle near the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 约二百三十伏，读下排刻度。

shots.scene: 小研读两只电流表，灯泡明亮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads the two ammeters while the bulbs glow brightly.
shots.narration: 读线电流和相电流，灯明显更亮。

shots.scene: 调压器回零，记录本打勾
shots.prompt_en: The autotransformer knob back at zero and a blank notebook with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 调压器回零，记好数据。

shots.scene: 星形图标旁两个等式
shots.prompt_en: A star icon with two equation icons beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 星形：线电流等于相电流。

shots.scene: 星形线电压箭头比相电压长一截
shots.prompt_en: A long line voltage arrow beside a shorter phase voltage arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 线电压是相电压的根号三倍。

shots.scene: 三角形图标旁两个等式
shots.prompt_en: A triangle icon with two equation icons beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 三角形：线电压等于相电压。

shots.scene: 三角形线电流箭头比相电流长一截
shots.prompt_en: A long line current arrow beside a shorter phase current arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 线电流是相电流的根号三倍。

shots.scene: 空白封面教材和举起的手
shots.prompt_en: A textbook with a blank cover next to a raised hand icon. No people.
shots.narration: 对照教材复习，有疑问就提出来。

shots.scene: 星形、三角形图标和两组等式
shots.prompt_en: Star and triangle icons each with their equation pair. No people.
shots.narration: 星形电流相等，三角形电压相等。

shots.scene: 调压器升压、读数、回零、断开四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: autotransformer knob up, meter reading, knob at zero, switch opened. No people.
shots.narration: 升压读数，回零断开。

shots.scene: 欣欣在三相实验台前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the three-phase lab bench.
shots.narration: 星形三角形学会了，下次见！
